projectState.summary: Branch-scoped candidate identity is implemented on codex/byte-branch-scoped-candidate-id and ready for review. The chosen mechanism keeps the existing single-column id primary key and prefixes explicit/generated candidate ids with a deterministic branch hash at write/develop time. Parent ids are scoped to the same branch, score/status/develop operations enforce branch ownership, and the browser pre-scopes writes while the server independently scopes and validates. Focused candidate smoke is green, including same-seed cross-branch isolation, same-branch no-duplicate reruns, and matched diversity-on/off branches in one store. Full validation remains to run before handoff.
